en.headline: Tram derails in Central after Citybus swerves to avoid child, no injuries
en.dek: A Citybus route 930 vehicle struck a tram on Des Voeux Road Central near Jubilee Street on Wednesday evening while avoiding a five-year-old girl who had stepped into the roadway; services later resumed.
body: A Citybus and a tram collided at the junction of Des Voeux Road Central and Jubilee Street in Central on Wednesday evening, causing the tram to leave the tracks. Police said no one on either vehicle was injured.

According to Citybus, the route 930 bus travelling westbound towards Tsuen Wan had to swerve after a pedestrian, later identified as a five-year-old girl accompanying her grandmother, suddenly entered the roadway. The bus then struck the adjacent tram. A crane was brought in to return the tram to the rails.

The Transport Department said some lanes on Des Voeux Road Central near Jubilee Street were temporarily closed until about 9:30 pm, after which tram services resumed normal operation. Police are investigating the incident and Citybus has temporarily suspended the driver from driving duties pending further inquiries.

zh.headline: 中環城巴閃避女童撞電車出軌 無人受傷
zh.dek: 周三晚一輛930線城巴在德輔道中近租庇利街為避一名突然衝出馬路的5歲女童而撞向電車，導致電車出軌，車上無人受傷，電車服務其後恢復。
body: 周三晚上約8時，中環德輔道中與租庇利街交界發生交通意外，一輛城巴與電車相撞，電車被撞至出軌。警方表示，兩車上無人受傷。
城巴指，事發時一輛930線往荃灣方向巴士沿德輔道中西行，一名與祖母同行的5歲女童突然衝出馬路，車長扭軚閃避期間撞向旁邊電車。其後吊臂車到場將電車移回路軌。
運輸署表示，德輔道中近租庇利街部分行車線一度封閉，至晚上約9時30分解封，電車服務亦已恢復正常。警方正調查事件，城巴已按機制暫時停止涉事車長的駕駛職務。
